#!/bin/bash
# Per-file fallback for a directory whose whole-dir run was killed: each test under
# its own 90s external timeout, merged into one expectation JSON by merge.py.
cd /c/Users/mark_/Code/repos/genet || exit 1
P=/c/Users/mark_/Code/testing/genet/wpt-ledger/2026-09-06_platform_census
BIN=/c/t/genet-platform-ledger-target/release/genet-wpt.exe
d=$1; tag=$(echo $d | tr '/' '_' | sed 's/\.html$//'); out=$P/perfile/$tag; mkdir -p $out
"$BIN" list "$d" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's/?.*//' | sort -u > $out/files.txt
i=0
while read t; do
  i=$((i+1)); n=$(echo $t | tr '/?' '__')
  timeout -k 5 90 "$BIN" testharness "$t" --engine boa --renderer livery --write-expectations "$out/$n.json" > "$out/$n.log" 2>&1
  rc=$?; [ $rc -ne 0 ] && echo "$t rc=$rc" >> $out/failed.txt
done < $out/files.txt
python $P/merge.py "$out" "$P/disk/${tag}_boa.json" "$P/disk/${tag}_boa.log"
echo "PERFILE DONE $d ($i files)"

merge.py.contents:
import json, glob, os, sys
out, dst, dstlog = sys.argv[1:4]
tests = {}; log = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(out, '*.json'))):
    try: tests.update(json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))['tests'])
    except Exception as e: pass
    lf = f[:-5] + '.log'
    if os.path.exists(lf): log += [l for l in open(lf, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') if l.startswith(('ERROR ','FAIL ','TIMEOUT '))]
# tests the runner never wrote a record for (killed by the external timeout)
for line in open(os.path.join(out, 'files.txt'), encoding='utf-8'):
    t = line.strip()
    if t and not any(k == t or k.startswith(t + '?') for k in tests):
        tests[t] = {'status': 'error', 'reason': 'hang-killed-90s'}
        log.append('ERROR %s  (hang-killed-90s)\n' % t)
json.dump({'command': 'testharness', 'engine': 'boa', 'renderer': 'livery', 'version': 1, 'note': 'per-file fallback; see perfile/', 'tests': dict(sorted(tests.items()))}, open(dst, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=1)
open(dstlog, 'w', encoding='utf-8').writelines(log)
print('merged', len(tests), 'records ->', dst)
